name: Galaxy Unit API
description: REST for AI agents and scripts. A key acts as the member who made it (never above admin) under row-level security. Money is a decimal string. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD in the business time zone (see /me). Errors carry code, field and a hint the agent can act on. Read /for-agents first: https://galaxyunit.app/for-agents
